circuit.name: Half Bridge LLC Resonant DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Isolated resonant DC-DC converter with an L-L-C tank for soft switching. Converts 24V input to 12V isolated output (0.6:1 step-down transformer) using frequency modulation for voltage regulation. All-NMOS half-bridge implementation.

requirements.requirement: Startup transient from 0V to regulated 12V output. LLC resonant converter is NON-INVERTING (output positive terminal at [Rout, pos] and [Cout, pos]). Measure VOUT at [Rout, pos] or [Cout, pos]. Verify soft-start behavior with minimal inrush current and overshoot.

environment.description: 15ms startup transient with 100ns timestep for resonant tank resolution

measurement.description: Output voltage measurement for startup transient

data.name: t_settle
data.description: Time when output settles to 95% of target (last crossing)

requirements.requirement: Steady-state operation at nominal 24V input and full load. Verify output voltage regulation at 12V with acceptable ripple. Measure resonant tank currents (Lr) and transformer primary voltage for ZVS verification.

environment.description: 15ms steady-state with 100ns resolution for resonant frequency capture

measurement.description: Transformer primary voltage for ZVS verification

outputs.description: RMS resonant inductor current in amperes
Peak resonant inductor current in amperes

requirements.requirement: Line regulation test: input voltage step from 20V to 28V (Ã‚Â±20% variation). Verify output voltage remains regulated at 12V with minimal transient deviation. LLC uses frequency modulation for regulation.

environment.description: 15ms transient for line step response with resonant settling

data.name: t_recovery
data.description: Recovery time to 98% of target (last crossing)

outputs.description: Maximum output voltage deviation in millivolts

requirements.requirement: Load transient response: step load change from 50% to 100% (light to heavy load). Verify output voltage recovery and transient overshoot/undershoot within acceptable limits. Measure resonant tank current change.

environment.description: 15ms transient for load step with resonant tank settling

data.name: ilr_max
data.description: Maximum resonant current during load step

data.name: ilr_min
data.description: Minimum resonant current during load step

data.name: t_recovery
data.description: Recovery time to 97% of target (last crossing)

outputs.description: Maximum output voltage deviation in millivolts

requirements.requirement: Efficiency measurement at nominal operating point (24V input, 12V output, full load). Calculate input power vs output power. Verify losses in resonant tank, transformer, and rectifier diodes.

environment.description: 15ms steady-state for power averaging over multiple resonant cycles

data.name: ilr_rms
data.description: RMS resonant inductor current for loss calculation

measurement.description: Resonant inductor current for loss analysis

data.name: id1_avg
data.description: Average D1 current for loss calculation

data.name: id2_avg
data.description: Average D2 current for loss calculation

requirements.requirement: Zero-Voltage Switching (ZVS) verification for primary-side MOSFETs (SW1, SW2). Measure drain-source voltage and gate drive timing to confirm voltage crosses zero before gate turn-on. Verify resonant tank current leads voltage for inductive operation.

environment.description: 15ms with 50ns timestep for precise ZVS transition capture

measurement.description: SW1 drain-source voltage for ZVS verification
SW2 drain-source voltage for ZVS verification

data.name: ilr_peak
data.description: Peak resonant current for ZVS margin

measurement.description: Resonant tank current for inductive operation verification

outputs.description: Minimum switch voltage across both switches

requirements.requirement: Component stress analysis: measure peak voltages and currents on resonant components (Lr, Cr), transformer primary/secondary, and rectifier diodes (D1, D2). Verify components operate within safe operating area.

environment.description: 15ms for peak stress measurement over resonant cycles

outputs.description: Peak resonant inductor current in amperes
RMS resonant inductor current in amperes
Peak resonant capacitor voltage in volts
Peak transformer primary voltage in volts
Peak D1 reverse voltage in volts
Peak D2 reverse voltage in volts
Maximum diode reverse voltage across both diodes
